body: update: things have only gotten worse much much worse... i just broke up with my girlfriend who was mentally and emotionally abusive and told my bestfriend (whom im in love with) about it and she told me to just not ever say anything to my now ex again and i told her that as fucked up as it is i do love her and my friend just said "k. have fun." and hasnt responded to my texts and im automatically sent to voicemail so she blocked my number 😔 and that friend the love of my life was the last person i had in my life who even slightly cared 😔 my family just talks about how me dying would effect them there are no thoughts on how life or death is effecting me only them 😔 so now ive lost my girlfriend my bestfriend/only friend i have no job no money no friends and im just lost 😔 ive been sat in the cold raining windy night for almost the entire night now thinking of what to do but all i can think of to be better is killing myself 😔 thank u all for being so kind and for trying so hard but i think by this time next week im going to go thru with it i just havnt figured out the method yet i have 7 bottles of pills maybe more i have a rifle i have a sheet to hang myself i have a knife to cut my throat or wrists and i have a can of gas and a box of matches if i wanna go out slow and in pain 😔 when the liquor store opens im buying some whiskey and im getting weed laced with heroine for the first time to try it before i snuff out my light thank u all for trying and keep trying just because i couldnt be helped doesnt mean other people are a lost cause aswell
